title: ILJO v1.0: PHI Synthetic Pilot Dataset
subtitle: Synthetic pilot dataset & pipeline for Indonesian PHI research
description: Independent research initiative directed by Cecep Mustafa, Ph.D. Contains 150 schema-validated, privacy-reviewed synthetic records (2021-2026) demonstrating the ILJO v1.0 data standard pending authorized access to Direktori Putusan Mahkamah Agung RI.
